sourceTitle: Lennox SL280DFNV installation instructions 508150-02 (04/2024), integrated control diagnostic codes
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
displayPattern: Seven-segment diagnostic LED on a Lennox SL280DFNV.
meaning: Soft lockout: recycles ran out, and the last recycle failed because the limit circuit opened, or the limit stayed open longer than 3 minutes. This is a 1-hour soft lockout.
causes: Limit circuit opened on the last recycle
Limit remained open longer than 3 minutes
diySteps: Turn the furnace off and make sure return and supply grilles are open and nothing is blocking them. Wait for the 1-hour soft lockout to end before judging a new call
Technician: check firing rate and airflow, and check for blockage. The code clears when a heat call finishes successfully
proAdvice: E274 is the recycle lockout for the limit circuit, including a limit that stayed open longer than 3 minutes. E250 is the open-limit row before that lockout, and E291 is the airflow-restriction lockout that names a dirty filter. If E274 returns, call a licensed HVAC technician.
